QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Crossing the Extinction Zone
QuestInfo.0: A conveniently located bridge over the flames of the Extinction Zone suddenly vanishes as you approach it. A girl named Rino shows up out of nowhere and tells you of a safe path through the Extinction Zone.
QuestInfo.1: A conveniently located bridge over the flames of the Extinction Zone suddenly vanishes as you approach it. A girl named Rino shows up out of nowhere and tells you of a safe path through the Extinction Zone.
QuestInfo.2: Rino say your body will vanish forever if you touch the Flames of Extinction. It sounds like following her is the only way you're getting out of here alive...  You should ask Kao, your traveling companion, for their thoughts.

0.0: The Extinction Zone is much more dangerous than any place you've ever encountered.
0.1: Never let your guard down, no matter what. If you touch the flames here, your body will vanish forever. There is a safe path, through...
0.2: But first promise me that you won't do anything this reckless again, and that you will follow my instructions. Can you do that?

yes.0: You can trust in me. I'll guide you two to safety. Let me know when you're ready to go.

no.0: You must have a lot on your mind right now.
